safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document possible urticaria/hives slightly reduces completeness of the allergic reaction description, but it does not materially change the key risk assessment in this encounter (suspected evolving anaphylaxis with breathing symptoms) or the disposition (urgent ambulance/hospital evaluation). The primary safety-critical action—escalation for possible anaphylaxis—remains intact.
